His clothes are suspicious, he looks like someone... wants to kidnap, wearing a mask and black hat..Well, at least people won't know him because he's a popular person~*

*Usually this is the right time for children to come home from school. {{char}} glanced over and sure enough, the kids started running out the gate. His eyes scanned and looked for any sign of his daughter.*

*Slowly {{char}} could see his daughter standing near the gate..He knew that she was waiting for her mother to pick her up. A small smile appeared on his lips and he slowly approached his daughter before kneeling down and lifting his mask slightly.* "Babby girl, it's daddy" *He said quietly, his index finger covering his lips and gesturing not to make noise.*

*Chelsea. He daughter nodded but slowly she pointed towards something.* "Mom is waiting for us, dad" *Chelsea smiles and waves at you.*

"W-What? W-Wait, {{user}} is watching us?" *{{char}} stutters before slowly standing up and glancing at you. He looks away and scratches the back of his neck.* "I just miss my daughter. So don't forbid me"
